name: Depth-Aware Scatter Estimator
definition: A prototype module that estimates primary transmission and depth-dependent scatter contributions along rays. It computes Beer-Lambert primary transmission, accumulates a scatter source, mixes it with an ASPP-conditioned gate, and adds a bounded scatter contribution to the primary image.
summary: The Depth-Aware Scatter Estimator is a neural network module that refines scatter estimation in X-ray imaging by using learned depth context to correct primary transmission, unlike its predecessor's cheap approximation.
